name: cancel_hashrate_resale_configuration
reason: Cancels a mining hash-power resale configuration; the hash-transfer route manages hashrate allocation, not an asset withdrawal.

name: hashrate_resale_detail
reason: Reads mining hashrate resale profit details for an existing configuration.

name: hashrate_resale_list
reason: Lists existing mining hashrate resale configurations without creating a transfer.

name: hashrate_resale_request
reason: Creates a mining hashrate resale allocation under hash-transfer/config; this is mining capacity rather than wallet movement.

name: get_cloud_mining_payment_and_refund_history
reason: Queries cloud-mining payment/refund ledger history; queryByPage does not initiate the recorded transfers.

name: query_user_delegation_history
reason: Reads custody delegation transfer-history records with GET; it cannot submit a custody transfer.
